overview: Simulation-based inference and flow-matching transformers dominate, applied to LISA galactic binaries and stochastic backgrounds, strong lenses, and gamma-ray millisecond pulsars. Emulators and benchmarks appear for Lyman-alpha forest mocks and global 21-cm inference. Stellar work uses XGBoost and invertible networks on Gaia photometry; cosmic-ray and wavefront studies use CNNs and Vision Transformers.
themes: Stellar parameter inference and AGB classification
